intro: Fenwick's Head is the grisly proof of execution taken from Fenwick Thatros on the shores of Lordamere Lake. It is claimed by Forsaken rogues operating on direct orders passed down through Lord Varimathras.

p: Within the Rogues' Quarter of the Undercity, Mennet Carkad acts on urgent intelligence routed directly from dreadlord Varimathras. A hostile undead leader named Fenwick Thatros has established a foothold near the decaying docks along Lordamere Lake in Silverpine Forest. To prevent this threat from rallying hostile undead against the Forsaken, Carkad dispatches promising Deathstalkers to locate Thatros, eliminate him, and sever his head as undeniable proof of the kill.

Returning Fenwick's Head to Carkad is more than a simple bounty collection; it serves as a crucial trial for Deathstalker operatives. Presenting the severed trophy validates the rogue's competence in infiltration and assassination, opening the door to deeper, more specialized instruction in the shadow arts from the Forsaken masters.
